explanation summary: From ages 30 to 65, cotesting every 5 years is an acceptable strategy, along with cytology every 3 years or primary high-risk HPV testing every 5 years.

explanation summary: Do not resume screening only because of a new partner.

explanation summary: The cervix is still present, so screening continues.

key: B. Aqueous crystalline penicillin G 18-24 million units daily for 10-14 days, with ear care
